Portland

Immediate detachment; governor gives expected rendezvous date; US officer musters/oath every officer/man; enlisted age18-45 and physical strength. Proclamation orders dispersal in20days, avoids devastation/interference with property/disturbance of peaceful citizens consistently with object.
Suppress the combinations obstructing United States law, execute the laws and maintain the National Union.
The probable first service is repossession of the forts, places and property seized from the Union, with the stated restraint toward property and peaceful citizens.
